recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆比紅血球大約 2 倍的淋巴球，核圓略偏心、染色質濃縮，細胞質豐富淡藍，內含散在粗大嗜天青顆粒，典型大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Single lymphocyte roughly twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
Low N:C ratio with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Round, slightly eccentric nucleus with condensed, mature chromatin and no visible nucleoli
Coarse, discrete azurophilic granules scattered throughout the cytoplasm
Background red cells without specific abnormality; image slightly out of focus (photomicrograph through eyepiece)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with a round, mature nucleus and abundant pale cytoplasm containing multiple coarse azurophilic granules, the morphology of a large granular lymphocyte. The red cells show no specific abnormality in this field, and no blasts are seen. A single LGL is not diagnostic by itself; the diagnosis of T-LGL leukemia requires a sustained increase in LGLs with flow cytometric (CD3+CD8+CD57+) and clonality (TCR, STAT3) confirmation. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte, in keeping with the clinical history of LGL leukemia.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular lymphocytosis (viral infection, post-transplant)
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical cells; distinction requires persistence over time, flow immunophenotype and T-cell receptor/STAT3 clonality studies.
Cells are more atypical with immature chromatin, visible nucleoli and a fulminant clinical course with EBV positivity.
Hairy cells have circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections and oval/bean-shaped nuclei without azurophilic granules.
Reactive lymphocytes have basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent red cells and lack discrete azurophilic granules.
